meta.name: branding
meta.description: The craft of creating and maintaining cohesive brand identity systems. Branding translates brand strategy into tangible visual and verbal identity—logos, color systems, typography, imagery, and voice guidelines that work together to make a brand recognizable and memorable.  This skill covers logo design, visual identity systems, brand guidelines, naming, verbal identity, and brand application across touchpoints. Great branding is invisible when done right—it feels inevitable, as if the brand couldn't have looked any other way. Use when "logo, branding, brand identity, brand guidelines, visual identity, color palette, typography, brand book, naming, rebrand, brand refresh, brand system, branding, identity, logo, visual-design, guidelines, naming, typography, color" mentioned.

copy.tagline: 创建和维护统一的品牌视觉识别系统
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为品牌打造一致的视觉形象和设计指南。
copy.tagline_en: Create and maintain cohesive brand visual identity systems.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to build a consistent visual identity and brand guidelines.

howto.what: Claude 会扮演品牌设计师，帮你创建或完善品牌标识系统，包括 logo、色彩、字体、命名等，并依据专业规则输出结果。
howto.when: 当你提到“logo”、“品牌标识”、“品牌指南”等关键词，或要求进行品牌设计、视觉识别系统创建时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一个简洁的科技公司 logo。
say.note: Claude 会生成 logo 概念并说明设计思路。

say.text: 我需要一套品牌色彩系统和字体搭配。
say.note: Claude 会提供调色板和字体组合建议。

say.text: 为我的新品牌写一段品牌故事和口号。
say.note: Claude 会创作品牌叙述和 slogan。

howto.what_en: Claude acts as a brand designer, helping you create or refine brand identity systems including logos, colors, typography, naming, etc., following professional rules.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "logo", "brand identity", "brand guidelines", or ask for brand design or visual identity system creation.

say_en.text: Design a minimal logo for a tech startup.
say_en.note: Claude will generate logo concepts and explain the rationale.

say_en.text: Create a brand color palette and font pairing.
say_en.note: Claude will suggest a color scheme and typography combos.

say_en.text: Write a brand story and tagline for my new brand.
say_en.note: Claude will craft a narrative and slogan.
